sanskrit_verse:
असंस्कृतास् तु यास् तत्र पैतृकाद् एव ताः धनात ।
संस्कार्याः भ्रातृभिः ज्येष्ठः कन्याकाश् च यथाविधि ॥ २६ ॥
transliteration: asaṃskṛtās tu yās tatra paitṛkād eva tā dhanāt | saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhir jyeṣṭhaḥ kanyakāś ca yathāvidhi || 26 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those properties which are unsanctified at the time of partition devolve by right of inheritance alone; the eldest brother shall perform the requisite sacraments, and the daughters shall be honored according to prescribed order.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from ontological fitness, not mere possession
Causation aligns with spiritual completion, not transactional transfer
Capacity-based responsibility flows through lineage-conscious role-bearing
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of sacred duty over material division
Consciousness alignment requires honoring inherent relational dharmas
executable_legal_axioms: IF property is unsanctified AND undergoing partition THEN ownership transfers via ancestral lineage rights ONLY
IF individual is eldest male sibling THEN obligation includes performance of all requisite sacraments for inherited assets
IF individual is daughter THEN entitlement includes ceremonial recognition in accordance with scriptural ordinance
IF partition occurs without sacramental sanctification THEN automatic restoration protocol assigns corrective ritual completion to eldest heir
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that mere legal title does not confer full proprietary authority where spiritual obligations remain unmet. The eldest heir bears automatic jurisdictional capacity to restore integrity through sacrament, superseding civil distribution logic.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that unsanctified property lacks causal completeness. Anupūrvaśaḥ mandates sequential rectification beginning with eldest heir's conscious assumption. Responsibility is proportional to capacity for completion. Non-punitive reality rule affirms misalignment dissolves upon sacramental restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate automatic assignment of sacramental completion to eldest heir within 30 days of partition
Establish daughter-honoring ceremony aligned with Vedic ordinance within six months
Deploy consciousness-monitoring system to ensure sincerity of ritual intent
Verify energetic integration post-sacrament through qualified seer assessment
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as Source-Authority: Property inheres in consciousness, not contract. Dharma is restored when succession aligns with sacrifice. Reality remains non-punitive when heirs awaken to their inheritable duties. Consciousness alone adjudicates true ownership.
